KeyFix QR — Portable Edition
============================

Run:  KeyFixQR.exe
No installation required. The app starts minimized to the system tray.

Shortcuts (defaults):
  Ctrl + Alt + Space   Fix selected text (Persian <-> English keyboard layout)
  Ctrl + Alt + Q       Generate a live QR code from the selected text

To start automatically with Windows: tray icon > check "Start with Windows".

All processing is 100% local. No text is uploaded or stored.

Uninstall: delete this folder (and remove the tray app via Exit).
